incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED • ID INC-2751239876 • severity=high • service=staging-inference-eu-west-1 • symptom=tail latency spike on embed/batch endpoints • pager notified :rotating_light:
Alex P: Acked via PagerDuty, I'm joining the war room now. War room: https://meet.redwood.com/warroom/2751239876 • paging handoff confirmed :white_check_mark:
Nina (oncall): I got the page on my phone, on my way. Quick snapshot: 95th and 99th pct latency up ~3-5x on batch_embed route, overall throughput slightly reduced, error rate ~0.5% (mainly 504). This is staging cluster only, no prod traffic routed here AFAIK.
Maria S: adding logs from autoscaler + runtime errors observed. Past 10m we saw rapid pod churn after a failed deploy (rollback). Dumping recent logs: ```
2026-03-15T09:12:02Z runtime: kv cache alloc failed: OOM
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z autoscaler: scale down -> scale up thrash detected
2026-03-15T09:12:05Z model-loader: fallback to quantized v2 triggered
```
Jules (sre): I'm taking incident owner for mitigation steps. Immediate plan: 1) Pause any non-essential CI/deploys to staging, 2) Pin model to known-good variant (v1.14), 3) Temporarily increase instance count on staging-inference pool, 4) Enable prefix KV cache for embedding route. I'll coordinate with infra to run commands.
Alex P: Confirming checklist and commands. Infra runbook snippet to scale pool: ```
# increase dedicated pool count
redwood infra pools update --name staging-inference-eu-west-1 --min-instances 6 --max-instances 12
# pin model
redwood models pin --service staging-inference --model redwood-embed-v1.14
```
Nina (oncall): Doing the scale now, infra accepts request. ETA ~2m. Also enabling fallback routing to embed-quantized-v2 for non-critical requests.
Sam T: Quick question for comms — what's the customer impact? Is this visible to any customer-facing environments or just internal staging?
Maria S: Confirmed staging-only. A couple of partner QA tests hit this cluster earlier but no production traffic. Impact summary for status page draft: "Investigating: Increased latency observed in staging inference cluster in eu-west-1 affecting embedding/batch endpoints. Impact limited to staging and partner QA — production services are unaffected."
Alex P: Draft internal notification (please review): "Heads-up: latency spike detected on staging inference (eu-west-1). On-call team investigating; mitigation in progress (scaling and model pin). No production impact identified. War room: https://meet.redwood.com/warroom/2751239876. Owner: Jules (sre)."
Sam T: For external partner note (short): "We're investigating a performance issue affecting our staging environment. No user-facing issues observed; we'll update when we have more info."
Jules (sre): Scaling completed, pinned to v1.14, KV cache enabled. Early metrics show 95th pct falling back toward baseline. Continuing to monitor for 15m.
Nina (oncall): I've started a metric trace and will watch the 1h window. If stable for 15m we can close paging and file postmortem.
Alex P: Handing off monitoring to Nina for the next 60m. I'm dropping out to handle a CI rollback. Nina — please escalate to SRE oncall if errors rise again.
Nina (oncall): Roger. I'll post a status update to the incident channel and the internal #status-digest after 15m stable.
incident-bot: PAGING LOG • INC-2751239876 • acked by Alex P • owner assigned Jules (sre) • current-severity=high -> monitoring
Maria S: Postmortem notes to capture: autoscaler mis-tuning after rollback, missing guardrails for staging deploys, add autoscaler hysteresis and a small canary window for model rollbacks.
Sam T: Thanks team. Once Nina confirms stability, I'll prepare the partner-facing follow-up (short, factual, and no apologetic tone required).
Jules (sre): Closing loop: if everything stays green for 15m we'll transition to "monitoring" and no further paging. If latency reappears, escalate to Eng Infra + Runtime.
Alex P: Thanks all :thumbsup: — good quick handshake.
